attchmntText: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has published its financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 in the newspapers Financial Express and Daily Taskeen. The company filed this notice with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The announcement was signed by Sadhvi Sharma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Financial Results for the Quarter and half year Ended September 30th ,2026".
voiceSummary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited submitted a media release regarding its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30th, 2026. The consolidated financial snapshot for the first half of FY27 shows revenue from operations at 714.13 Cr, compared to 636.21 Cr in H1-FY26. EBITDA stands at 35.82 Cr, with an EBITDA margin of 4.99%. Profit before tax is reported at 21.92 Cr, and profit after tax is 16.61 Cr, representing a PAT margin of 2.31%. These figures are contrasted with H1-FY26 results where revenue was 636.21 Cr, EBITDA was 35.78 Cr, and PAT was 15.25 Cr. The company highlighted strong business resilience and operational performance during the July to September quarter.

attchmntText: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the Netherlands.
voiceSummary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the Netherlands. The Board of Directors made this decision during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. Sarveshwar Foods Limited will hold 100% of the shareholding in the new entity. The subscription to the share capital will be made in cash. The name of the proposed entity is yet to be approved by the relevant authorities. The date of incorporation is not yet determined. The entity is currently not incorporated. The industry and business background are yet to be ascertained. This information is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about unsecured Loan Agreement entered between Sarveshwar Foods Limited and Sarveshwar Overseas Limited
voiceSummary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited entered into an unsecured loan agreement with its subsidiary, Sarveshwar Overseas Limited, on 13 November 2026. The agreement allows the parent company to lend an aggregate amount not exceeding INR 25 Crores in one or more tranches. The subsidiary will utilize the funds for general corporate purposes. Sarveshwar Foods Limited holds 99% shares in the borrower. The transaction is classified as a related party transaction conducted at arm's length. No security is provided for the loan. The current outstanding loan amount is INR 12.99 crores. The agreement does not include special rights regarding director appointments or share subscriptions.

attchmntText: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Sarveshwar Foods Limited Explores Strategic Opportunities to Strengthen Logistics and Warehousing Infrastructure".
voiceSummary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited submitted a press release on November 13, 2026, stating it is exploring strategic opportunities to strengthen logistics and warehousing infrastructure. The company is evaluating alternatives, including establishing a dedicated logistics business, to support export, organic, and B2B distribution operations. A dedicated committee may be constituted to assess commercial viability. The initiative is at a preliminary exploratory stage. No final decision has been taken. Any material developments will be disclosed to stock exchanges.

attchmntText: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has submitted to the Exchange regrading the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results along with limited review Report for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited reviewed and approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board also approved the incorporation of a new wholly owned subsidiary in the Netherlands. The company plans to establish a dedicated logistics and warehousing business to support domestic and international operations. The Board discussed constituting a committee to evaluate strategic alternatives for this expansion. The meeting commenced at 12:30 P.M. and concluded at 8:30 P.M. on 13th November 2026. Financial results are available on the company website.
